vocabulary.Terminal: A shell session and its interactive UI; older code may call it a shell or session.
vocabulary.Connection: A paired Mac plus the currently selected network route.
vocabulary.Attachment: A client joined to a shared Terminal. Protocol and CLI attachment names remain exact.

reviews.reason: Daemon instance locking and ownership-safe control-socket cleanup preserve the existing macOS and iOS surfaces and resource relationships.
Branch naming guidance affects contributor workflow only and does not change any mapped user interface component or resource relationship.
Stale local terminal recovery changes daemon session lifecycle behavior without changing mapped user interface components or their resource relationships.
Agent issue-creation guidance and its pre-pull-request validation requirement do not change mapped user interface components or resource relationships.
HIG reference, naming guidance, and audit-skill documentation do not change mapped user interface components or their resource relationships.
